Actual constant good reframing and a bad shear yield s*c_mu=gamma*t^(mu+1) and f_mu=gamma*tau^(mu+1). results.graph: If the normalized generic y has degree one, deg(Psi)<=mu+1 makes the quotient of Psi minus its affine graph parameter by Phi a coefficient-field constant. The graph slope is complex constant. Actual low-weight shears remove mixed jets; the resulting exact one-variable coefficient-field relation descends by rational-pencil weight comparison to an invariant ambient coordinate.
results.suspension: Given I=XW-F(Y)-delta*Z invariant with degF=mu+1>=3, the supplied derivative bounds and fixed-point freeness force EX to be a complex unit. Wang's exact-field two alternatives, original coefficient comparison and the root fixed-point contradiction give explicit polynomial generators of A. The same selected primitive action is sliced in this graph/suspension regime.
results.quartic: For mu=3, the nested generic degree pair (2,4) is impossible. Exact coefficient identities yield an invariant of weight five and an actual Nagata-type automorphism with two invariant coordinates. E^2 of the original third good forces a square to have odd valuation at a linear coordinate prime.
results.exhaustion: AMS degree divisibility makes the graph condition automatic whenever mu+1 is prime. For mu=3, the only degree pairs are (1,4) and (2,4); graph recognition and nested exclusion exhaust them. Thus mu=3 and mu=4 are newly recognized, along with all graph cases in arbitrary degree.
